description: This file defines the java class 'TableSwitch', which extends 'Table' and appears to be part of a GUI application related to ROM or ECU parameter configuration. It manages switch-type table data, interacts with UI elements like radio buttons, and provides methods for populating and saving table data, as well as comparison and rendering logic.
